title: Result
description: companion → plugin. The one answer to a call, carrying the call's callId and exactly one of payload (success) or error. A result whose callId matches no call in flight is discarded by the plugin: it is late, or it was never asked for.

v.description: Protocol version. A shape change is a new version, never an edit of v1 in place.

callId.description: The callId of the call this answers, verbatim.

payload.description: The operation's output on success, opaque to the wire. Bounded with the frame at 262144 encoded bytes. Never logged, on either side.

class.description: The wire's transport-level class, a closed vocabulary. unknown_op: the companion serves no such op. not_permitted: the op exists and this call may not make it. timed_out: deadlineMs passed first. upstream_failed: the platform refused or failed, or the connection it needed was lost; its own typed error is in upstream. malformed_payload: the frame broke its bound or the op's input did not parse.

instruction.description: The sentence the agent relays to the person (decision 32). Platform vocabulary, never tenant content.

upstream.description: The control plane's own typed error, opaque to the wire, when there is one.

error.description: Present exactly when the call failed.
